task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement QAOA (p=2) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 4), (2, 3), (3, 4)]. Build the cost and mixer layers manually, optimize with scipy, and print the best cut found. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
